Privacy Policy

Last updated November 5, 2026

Blockbuster Zone is owned and operated by Sean O'Friel. This page explains, in plain language, what information this site does and does not collect.

What we collect

Almost nothing. Blockbuster Zone has no accounts, no sign-ups, no comment forms, and no checkout. We do not ask for or collect your name, email address, or payment details, and the site itself sets no cookies and runs no advertising or analytics trackers.

Features that stay in your browser

The movie search and the “My List” feature run entirely in your browser on your device. Your My List picks are kept only in the page's memory while the page is open — they are not saved, stored, or sent anywhere, and they clear when you reload or leave the page.

Hosting and external links

This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub may automatically log standard technical information (such as IP addresses and browser types) when your browser requests a page; that is governed by GitHub's own privacy policy, not by us. Pages on Blockbuster Zone link out to sources such as Entertainment Weekly, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic and Box Office Mojo — those sites have their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their practices.

Email

If you email us through the Contact Us page, we receive the information in your email (such as your email address and message) and use it only to reply to you. We do not sell or share it.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page with a new date. Questions about privacy can be sent through the Contact Us page.
